answer: An agent can only withdraw once its payout account clears a micro-deposit name match, where the sponsoring bank compares the account holder legal name and tax identifier against the two small deposits it just sent. A Nacha return code R05 on any second claim trips a return rate audit, closes the account and bills the originator 5.50 for every returned item. Opening one verified account costs 14 in identity checks plus two deposits at 0.31, so N fakes cost N x 14.62 and each still needs a real name match. A haven badge, a pearl icon and a ripple animation on a profile change none of that.
